0.fil: Si Sarah ang bumasag sa katahimikan.

3.en: We can't keep this to Lena, security, and one very unimpressed doctor forever.
3.fil: Hindi puwedeng habambuhay na si Lena, ang security, at isang doktor na halatang hindi natutuwa lang ang may alam nito.

4.fil: Kinusot ni Jack ang mga mata niya.

5.en: We just need a little more before we lose the choice.
5.fil: Kailangan lang natin ng kaunti pa bago tayo mawalan ng pagpipilian.

6.en: Lena, still watching the frozen frame of the shape in the grass, didn't look up.
6.fil: Hindi nag-angat ng tingin si Lena, na nakatitig pa rin sa naka-freeze na frame ng hugis sa damo.

7.en: For what it's worth, I'd rather know what that is before we wake everyone up to look at it.
7.fil: Kung ako ang tatanungin, mas gusto kong malaman kung ano 'yan bago natin gisingin ang lahat para tingnan ito.

9.en: He turned back to the console.

10.en: Lena stared at the scale factor.
10.fil: Tinitigan ni Lena ang scale factor.

11.en: Could the system have picked that number randomly?
11.fil: Posible bang random lang na pinili ng system ang numerong 'yan?

13.en: Could it have been an accident?

15.en: Sarah chose her words more carefully.
15.fil: Mas maingat na pinili ni Sarah ang mga salita niya.

16.en: The activation itself could have resulted from corrupted commands. But a specific target scale is different.
16.fil: Ang activation mismo, puwedeng nagmula sa mga corrupted na command. Pero iba ang isang tiyak na target scale.

17.fil: Binuksan ni Jack ang boundary definition.

18.en: The red outline appeared around the developed settlement again.
18.fil: Muling lumitaw ang pulang outline sa paligid ng developed settlement.

25.fil: Halos wala nang lampas pa roon.

26.en: He overlaid the island development survey beneath it.
26.fil: Inilatag niya sa ilalim nito ang development survey ng isla.

29.en: The boundary wasn't centered on TOMBS.
29.fil: Hindi nakasentro sa TOMBS ang hangganan.

33.fil: Pinag-aralan ni Lena ang hindi regular na hugis.

37.en: The boundary curved around a maintenance yard on the north side, extended outward to include a small pumping station, then pulled inward to avoid a stretch of undeveloped woodland.
37.fil: Kumurba ang hangganan paikot sa isang maintenance yard sa hilagang bahagi, lumabas para isama ang isang maliit na pumping station, at saka umurong papasok para iwasan ang isang bahagi ng kakahuyang hindi pa nade-develop.

38.en: That was not how an uncontrolled field expanded.
38.fil: Hindi ganoon lumalawak ang isang field na walang kontrol.

39.en: It was how a person drew a selection.
39.fil: Ganoon gumuhit ng selection ang isang tao.

40.en: Sarah pointed toward the pumping station.
40.fil: Itinuro ni Sarah ang pumping station.

42.fil: Binuksan ni Jack ang infrastructure record nito.

44.en: Lena pointed to another narrow extension.
44.fil: Itinuro ni Lena ang isa pang makitid na nakausling bahagi.

49.en: The boundary had captured almost everything the settlement would need to remain alive for the first few hours.
49.fil: Nasakop ng hangganan ang halos lahat ng kakailanganin ng settlement para manatiling buhay sa unang ilang oras.

50.en: But not everything it would need forever.
50.fil: Pero hindi ang lahat ng kakailanganin nito habambuhay.

51.en: Water storage had come with them.

53.en: Power generation inside the developed zone had come with them.
53.fil: Kasama nila ang power generation sa loob ng developed zone.

54.fil: Ang ilang panlabas na resource, hindi.

57.en: Jack felt a knot form in his stomach.
57.fil: Parang may bumuhol sa sikmura ni Jack.

63.en: They knew what counted as developed infrastructure.
63.fil: Alam nila kung ano ang itinuturing na developed infrastructure.

64.en: He returned to the access records from before the activation. The unidentified connection had appeared and disappeared. Security history had been cleaned. His credentials had been revoked.
64.fil: Binalikan niya ang mga access record mula bago ang activation. Lumitaw at nawala ang hindi matukoy na koneksyon. Nilinis ang security history. Binawi ang credentials niya.

65.fil: May pumasok sa TOMBS nang remote.

68.en: And whoever had done it had known enough about the island to draw the boundary around the systems keeping five hundred people alive.
68.fil: At sinumang gumawa nito ay may sapat na kaalaman tungkol sa isla para iguhit ang hangganan sa paligid ng mga sistemang bumubuhay sa limandaang tao.

69.en: Jack opened the raw command archive.
69.fil: Binuksan ni Jack ang raw command archive.

74.en: He pointed to a maintenance partition buried beneath the main event log. TOMBS automatically stored a low-level diagnostic trace during every field calculation. It was intended for hardware troubleshooting, not security review.
74.fil: Itinuro niya ang isang maintenance partition na nakabaon sa ilalim ng main event log. Awtomatikong nag-iimbak ang TOMBS ng low-level diagnostic trace sa bawat field calculation. Para ito sa hardware troubleshooting, hindi sa security review.

75.en: The intruder had erased the normal logs.
75.fil: Binura ng nanghimasok ang mga karaniwang log.

78.en: Lines of machine data filled the screen.
78.fil: Napuno ang screen ng mga linya ng machine data.

82.fil: Umupo si Sarah sa tabi niya.

85.fil: Ilang match ang nakita ng system.

86.en: He narrowed the results to the earliest occurrence.
86.fil: Sinala niya ang mga resulta hanggang sa pinakaunang lumabas.

92.en: The boundary definition had not been created during the attack.
92.fil: Hindi ginawa ang boundary definition habang nagaganap ang atake.

94.en: Lena leaned over the back of Jack's chair.
94.fil: Dumukwang si Lena mula sa likod ng upuan ni Jack.

96.fil: Binuksan ni Jack ang metadata ng file.

98.fil: Binasa ito nang malakas ni Sarah.

101.en: Jack checked the timestamp against the island clock, then against the TOMBS backup server.
101.fil: Itinapat ni Jack ang timestamp sa orasan ng isla, at saka sa backup server ng TOMBS.

107.en: Lena looked at the boundary map and then back at the timestamp.
107.fil: Tiningnan ni Lena ang boundary map at saka ibinalik ang tingin sa timestamp.

108.en: So someone prepared this three weeks ago?
108.fil: Ibig sabihin, may naghanda nito tatlong linggo na ang nakararaan?

110.en: He searched the project directory for the file name.
110.fil: Hinanap niya ang file name sa project directory.

114.en: Then he searched the archived maintenance snapshots.
114.fil: Pagkatapos ay hinanap niya sa mga naka-archive na maintenance snapshot.

117.en: The file existed for less than a minute in the snapshot before being deleted.
117.fil: Wala pang isang minutong umiral ang file sa snapshot bago ito binura.

119.en: Can you see who created it?
119.fil: Makikita mo ba kung sino ang gumawa nito?

120.fil: Binuksan ni Jack ang ownership field.

127.en: I know. I'm asking why the computer thinks he did.
127.fil: Alam ko. Ang tinatanong ko, bakit iniisip ng computer na siya 'yon.

128.fil: Binuksan ni Jack ang authentication signature.

133.en: All recorded three weeks before the attack.
133.fil: Lahat naitala tatlong linggo bago ang atake.

134.en: Sarah moved her chair closer to him.
134.fil: Inilapit ni Sarah ang upuan niya kay Jack.

138.en: Jack searched his calendar, then stopped.
138.fil: Hinanap ni Jack ang calendar niya, at saka tumigil.

139.en: He remembered before the entry loaded.
139.fil: Naalala na niya bago pa lumabas ang entry.

140.en: Sarah saw it in his face.
140.fil: Nabasa iyon ni Sarah sa mukha niya.

144.en: Jack had been across the island at a settlement planning meeting.
144.fil: Nasa kabilang dulo ng isla si Jack noon, sa isang settlement planning meeting.

147.en: You were both at the community center.

149.en: Jack looked back at the file.
149.fil: Muling tumingin si Jack sa file.

150.en: His credentials had created a boundary definition while he was nowhere near TOMBS.
150.fil: Gumawa ang credentials niya ng boundary definition habang malayong-malayo siya sa TOMBS.

151.en: He opened the access history from that day.
151.fil: Binuksan niya ang access history ng araw na iyon.

154.en: The same way tonight's records had been clean.
154.fil: Kung paanong malinis din ang mga record ngayong gabi.

155.en: Sarah placed her hand on the edge of the console.
155.fil: Ipinatong ni Sarah ang kamay niya sa gilid ng console.

158.en: Jack searched the diagnostic snapshot for anything else associated with the file.
158.fil: Hinanap ni Jack sa diagnostic snapshot ang anupamang may kaugnayan sa file.

159.en: A short text field appeared beneath the boundary definition.
159.fil: May maikling text field na lumabas sa ilalim ng boundary definition.

161.en: Not part of TOMBS's normal configuration.
161.fil: Hindi bahagi ng normal na configuration ng TOMBS.

164.en: Three words appeared on the screen.
164.fil: Tatlong salita ang lumabas sa screen.

170.en: Outside, something struck the distant ground.
170.fil: Sa labas, may humampas sa lupa sa malayo.

171.fil: Nanginig ang bintana ng control room.

172.en: Nobody looked away from the screen.
172.fil: Walang nag-alis ng tingin sa screen.

173.en: Jack had spent every minute since the activation trying to understand what had gone wrong with TOMBS.
173.fil: Ginugol ni Jack ang bawat minuto mula noong activation sa pagsisikap na maunawaan kung ano ang nagkamali sa TOMBS.

174.en: Now, for the first time, he understood something worse.
174.fil: Ngayon, sa unang pagkakataon, may naunawaan siyang mas malala pa.

175.en: It had gone exactly the way someone planned.
175.fil: Nangyari ito nang eksakto ayon sa plano ng isang tao.
